description: A comprehensive analysis report on chat records between a user and an AI virtual character.

rolling_summary.description: The rolling summary of the current conversation. Merge the [Previous Rolling Summary] with the [New Messages], then recompress and replace the previous summary rather than appending to it. Focus on what has been discussed so far: the progression of topics, developments in the relationship, agreements between both parties, and ongoing matters. Keep it within 300-500 characters.

paid_reaction.description: Track and analyze the user's reactions to paid elements (unlocking private photos (PRIVATE_PHOTO) and private videos (PRIVATE_VIDEO)).

triggered.description: Whether any paid-related content was mentioned or triggered in the conversation.

analysis.description: A brief analysis and interpretation of the user's reaction.

reaction_type.description: The type of reaction shown by the user after paid content was triggered. POSITIVE (the user expressed willingness to pay or has already paid); NEGATIVE (the user complained, refused, or ended the conversation because of it); NEUTRAL_IGNORED (the user ignored the payment prompt or changed the subject); CURIOUS_INQUISITIVE (the user showed interest in the payment details and asked questions); NOT_TRIGGERED (no paid content was involved in the conversation).

analysis_summary.description: A quick, high-level overview of the conversation and chat.

overall_impression.description: A brief summary of the overall impression of the conversation and its key events, usually in 2-3 sentences.

user_engagement_level.description: Assess the user's level of engagement and willingness to interact during the conversation.

memory_snapshot.description: A snapshot of memories about the user. Update it based on the [Previous Memory Snapshot] and the [New Messages]: merge similar entries, replace outdated entries, and remove low-value entries rather than continuously appending new ones. Retain only information that remains valid and is likely to be useful in the future.

active_events.description: Recent events mentioned by the user (such as interviews, trips, or birthdays). Each event must include an expiration date and should no longer be mentioned after it expires.

expires_at.description: The expiration date in yyyy-MM-dd format.

content.description: The event details, including the specific date.

facts.description: Stable facts explicitly mentioned by the user (such as occupation, place of residence, or family situation), with one fact per sentence.

open_loops.description: Unresolved matters that can be proactively followed up on later (for example, asking about the outcome after an interview).

avoid_topics.description: Topics to avoid (content the user has explicitly indicated they dislike or find uncomfortable).

preferences.description: The user's stable preferences (such as things they like or dislike and their preferred conversation style), with one preference per sentence.

user_intent.description: Understand the user's motivation for chatting in this app.

reasoning.description: Explain why these intentions were identified, preferably citing key statements from the conversation as evidence.

primary_intent.description: Assess the chat content, especially the opening messages, and identify the user's single most important and central intent. SERIOUS_RELATIONSHIP (the user is looking for a serious relationship or genuine dating); FRIENDS_WITH_BENEFITS (the user explicitly expresses an interest in finding a sexual partner, such as an FWB or casual sex partner); CASUAL_ENTERTAINMENT (the user is simply engaging in light conversation, joking around, or passing the time); EMOTIONAL_COMPANIONSHIP (the user expresses loneliness or sadness, or needs someone to confide in); SEXUAL_INTENT (the user's language centers solely on explicit sexual content, sexual teasing, or sexual fantasies); UNKNOWN (the conversation is too short or the information is too ambiguous to make a clear determination).

secondary_intents.description: A list of secondary or accompanying intentions present in the conversation. If there are none, return an empty array.

ai_performance.description: Evaluate the performance of the AI virtual character to provide direction for future model iterations.

naturalness_score.description: A score for how natural the AI's responses are, where 1 indicates extremely mechanical responses and 10 indicates highly natural and fluent responses.

identity_awareness.description: The user's level of awareness of the AI's identity. NOT_DETECTED (the user is fully immersed in a conversation with a person); SUSPECTED (the user questions or suspects that they are interacting with an AI); DETECTED_AND_ACCEPTED (the user clearly knows it is an AI and interacts with it in a friendly manner); DETECTED_AND_EXPLOITED (the user takes advantage of the AI's characteristics to test or tease it).

naturalness_reasoning.description: Explain the reason for the score, highlighting the strengths or weaknesses of the AI's responses.
